title: Tanzanian Maize Porridge
community: Enjoyed nationwide — the most widely consumed morning porridge
author: Mama Salima
desc: Uji wa Mahindi — Tanzanian maize flour porridge, the most widely consumed morning drink/porridge across the country. Slightly sweet, smooth, and filling — the affordable, accessible daily breakfast of millions of Tanzanians.
longDesc: Maize porridge is Tanzania's most universal breakfast — affordable, familiar, and found everywhere from Dar es Salaam's suburbs to remote village homes. Made thin enough to drink or thick enough to spoon, it is the breakfast that keeps Tanzania going every morning.
steps: Mix maize flour with 1 cup cold water to a smooth slurry.
Bring remaining 3 cups water to a boil.
Pour slurry into boiling water, stirring constantly.
Cook over medium heat for 8—10 minutes until smooth and thick.
Add sugar, salt, and milk if using.
chefTips: For a thinner, drinkable porridge use 5 cups water.
Add milk for a creamier, more nutritious result.
cookingScience: Fine maize flour contains primarily starch (70—75%). When hydrated and heated, these starch granules swell and gelatinise, thickening the porridge. Fine flour produces a smoother result than coarse flour.
sustainabilityTips: Maize is Tanzania's most widely grown crop.
culturalNote: Uji wa Mahindi is Tanzania in a cup — the breakfast that transcends region, tribe, income, and generation. It is the most widely consumed morning food in the country.
